about: PickSetGo started with a simple frustration. I wanted an app that could generate varied, interesting and challenging workouts using the equipment I already owned.

Most of the fitness apps I tried offered fixed workouts, often limited to bodyweight exercises or a small selection of equipment. Others offered workout generation, but I struggled to find anything that combined enough variety, flexibility and challenge without an expensive subscription.
Something that could make the most of whatever equipment I had available, keep workouts fresh and adapt to the time I had and how hard I wanted to train.
So I started building PickSetGo for myself — a workout generator designed around the way I actually wanted to train.
PickSetGo has grown beyond workout generation to include structured training programmes, warm-ups, mobility and recovery sessions.
But the original idea remains the same: make it easy to get a varied, worthwhile workout without having to spend time planning it yourself.
howToUse: How does PickSetGo generate workouts?
PickSetGo builds workouts around your available time, equipment, chosen focus and difficulty level.
It selects exercises from its library and combines them into a structured workout, aiming for a good balance of variety, challenge and recovery.
Each workout is generated for you, rather than selected from a fixed collection of prerecorded sessions.
How does workout difficulty work?
PickSetGo offers three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal and Hard.
Easy: A gentler workout, with more accessible exercises and a manageable level of effort.
Normal: A balanced workout with a moderate level of challenge.
Hard: A more demanding workout, using more challenging exercises and workout combinations where appropriate.
Difficulty influences how workouts are generated, but how hard a session feels will also depend on your fitness, the equipment available and the type of workout.
Choose the level that suits you, and adjust it as your fitness and confidence develop.
What's the difference between Generator and Coach?
Generator lets you create an individual workout whenever you want. Choose your available time, equipment, workout focus and difficulty, and PickSetGo puts together a session for you.
Coach provides a more structured approach to training. Choose a programme based on your goals, and PickSetGo plans a sequence of workouts designed to help you develop over time.
How does PickSetGo track my progress?
PickSetGo records your completed workouts, including the exercises performed, so you can look back at your training history.
Coach also uses your workout history to help plan future sessions and track your progress through a programme.
You can review your activity in Your progress, found under More.
How do I back up and restore my data?
PickSetGo saves your training information on your device rather than automatically syncing it between devices.
To keep a copy of your data, go to Settings → Backup & Restore and follow the instructions to create a backup file.
You can use the same screen to restore your data from a previously saved backup, including when moving to a new device.
help: A workout won't start or load
If a workout isn't loading or won't start, try the following:
Close and reopen PickSetGo.
If you're using PickSetGo in a browser, try refreshing the page.
Try generating or opening the workout again.
If the problem continues, go to Help & troubleshooting → Diagnostics and copy the relevant diagnostic information to help report the issue.
Important: Avoid clearing your browser or app data, as this could remove your saved training history.
Timer or sound isn't working
If the workout timer or audio isn't working as expected:
Try pausing and resuming the workout.
If there's no sound, check your device's volume and sound settings.
If spoken instructions aren't working, go to Settings → Spoken Cues and try previewing a voice.
If the problem continues, close and reopen PickSetGo after finishing or exiting your workout.
If the issue persists, go to Help & troubleshooting → Diagnostics and copy the app diagnostics to help report the problem.
My training history looks wrong
If your training history appears incomplete or incorrect:
Open More → Your progress and check whether the workout appears in your training history.
Make sure you're using the same device and browser where you completed your workouts. PickSetGo doesn't automatically synchronise training data between devices.
If you've recently restored a backup, check whether it contains the workouts you're expecting.
If your training history still looks incorrect, go to Help & troubleshooting → Diagnostics and copy the app diagnostics to help report the problem.
Important: Don't clear your browser data, reinstall PickSetGo or restore another backup without first making a backup of your current data, as these actions could result in data loss.
The app isn't displaying correctly
If PickSetGo looks unusual, parts of the screen are missing, or buttons aren't displaying correctly:
Close and reopen PickSetGo.
If you're using PickSetGo in a browser, try refreshing the page.
Check whether the problem also occurs when switching between light and dark mode under Settings → Appearance.
If the problem continues, go to Help & troubleshooting → Diagnostics and copy the app diagnostics to help report the issue.
Important: Avoid clearing your browser or app data, as this could remove your saved training history.
Report a problem
If you've encountered a problem with PickSetGo that you haven't been able to resolve, please get in touch.
When reporting a problem, it helps to include:
A brief description of what went wrong.
What you were doing when it happened.
A screenshot, if relevant.
Diagnostic information, which you can copy from the section below.
Please don't include passwords or other sensitive personal information.
